blocks.instruction: Leia o texto e escolha a alternativa correta. Algumas perguntas pedem inferência — a resposta não está escrita com todas as letras.
blocks.passage:
At work, it is important to know what you like and what you don't. When you know this, you feel better and you work better too.

In English, we often say "I like + verb-ing". For example: I like working, I like helping, and I like learning. It is simple and powerful.

Today you learn five important words: like, enjoy, prefer, learn, and help. We go step by step. Remember: English comes in CAN's, not in CAN'Ts. You can do it!

items.q: What is important at work, according to the text?
options: To know what you like and don't like
items.why: "it is important to know what you like and what you don't."

items.q: Which structure does the text teach?
items.why: "we often say 'I like + verb-ing'": I like working, helping, learning.

items.q: How many important words do you learn today?
items.why: "Today you learn five important words: like, enjoy, prefer, learn, and help."

items.q: The sentence "English comes in CAN's, not in CAN'Ts" suggests that the author wants you to feel…
items.why: Inferência: a frase é um incentivo — foco no que você PODE fazer, não no que não pode.

items.q: The author would most likely AGREE that…
options: knowing what you like helps you at work
your feelings at work are not important
English is only for the boss
you should learn one hundred words today
items.why: Inferência: o texto liga conhecer suas preferências a trabalhar melhor e se sentir melhor.

blocks.instruction: Ouça Sophie falando com um novo colega. Responda sem ler a transcrição — ela só aparece depois de corrigir.

audio.text:
Hi, welcome to the team! My name is Sophie. I like meeting new people, so I am very happy you are here today.

Every week, I ask new hires one simple question: what do you like about your job? For me, I enjoy helping people every day. I also like learning new things, and I prefer to start with a small task in the morning. When the morning task is done, I feel ready for the day.

Now, tell me a little about you. Do you like working with numbers, or do you prefer talking to clients? Do you enjoy reading reports, or do you like solving problems? There is no wrong answer here. I just want to know what motivates you, because that helps me help you.

When you know what you like, your work is easier and more fun. So please, take your time and settle in. If you have a question, my door is always open. We can talk again tomorrow, and I will show you the office. Welcome to Czarnikow, and welcome aboard!
audio.label: Ouça quantas vezes precisar. A transcrição aparece depois de corrigir.

items.q: What does Sophie ask new hires every week?
options: What they like about their job
items.why: "I ask new hires one simple question: what do you like about your job?"

items.q: What does Sophie enjoy doing every day?
items.why: "I enjoy helping people every day."

items.q: What does Sophie prefer to do in the morning?
items.why: "I prefer to start with a small task in the morning."

items.q: Sophie says "there is no wrong answer." This suggests she wants the new hire to feel…
options: relaxed and free to be honest
items.why: Inferência: ela tira a pressão para a pessoa responder com sinceridade.

items.q: How does Sophie feel about the new colleague?
options: She is very serious and cold
items.why: Inferência: ela diz que gosta de conhecer pessoas e repete "welcome" — tom acolhedor.

blocks.instruction: O vocabulário da lição aparece aqui em frases novas. Escolha o sentido ou a palavra que cabe no contexto.

items.q: "I enjoy working with the team." Enjoy is close in meaning to…
items.why: Enjoy = curtir / gostar muito de algo.

items.q: Choose the correct word: "I ___ morning meetings, not afternoon meetings."
items.why: Prefer = preferir uma coisa em vez de outra.

items.q: "I like learning new things at work." To learn means to…
items.why: Learn = aprender, ganhar conhecimento novo.

items.q: Choose the correct word: "I enjoy ___ my colleagues when they have a problem."
items.why: Help = ajudar; com like/enjoy usamos help + -ing (helping).

items.q: "I like my job." The word like here means…
options: to have good feelings about something
items.why: Aqui like é o verbo gostar: ter bons sentimentos por algo.

blocks.instruction: Expressões simples de trabalho. Escolha o sentido no contexto.

items.q: "On your first day, the team says welcome aboard." This means…
items.why: Welcome aboard = boas-vindas ao time / à empresa.

items.q: "Please fill in this short form." To fill in means to…
items.why: Fill in = preencher (escrever as informações).

items.q: "I get on with my colleagues very well." This means I…
options: have a good relationship with them
items.why: Get on with someone = ter uma boa relação com a pessoa.

items.q: "Sophie looks after the new hires." To look after means to…
items.why: Look after = cuidar de alguém.

items.q: "Take your time and settle in." To settle in means to…
options: get used to a new place
items.why: Settle in = se acostumar / se adaptar a um lugar novo.
